description: Frames and HELLO of a connection on the local network (spec/transports.md, section 4).

vectors.description: cat-a-log's HELLO as the client
Old Brain Fix's HELLO as the server
the server takes the client's HELLO, the DATA of protocol.md, section 17.5, and a PING
the client takes the server's HELLO with the key of the QR code
a chain at the start, with a DEVICE_ADD signed with another key, then the sender's messages
a DEVICE_REMOVE signed with another key after another message
a MESSAGE above 16 MiB is skipped and reported, or the connection closed
close on a HELLO for another certificate, passed on by a machine in the middle
close on the server's own HELLO sent back to it
close on a HELLO with another key than the QR code's
close on a HELLO with a changed signature
close on a HELLO with a key of small order
close on a HELLO of 95 bytes
close on a MESSAGE before the HELLO
close on a PING before the HELLO
close on a second HELLO
close on a message whose sender is not the key of the HELLO
close on an empty MESSAGE
close on a PING with a payload
close on an unknown frame type
close on a frame cut short by the end of the connection
close on a DEVICE_JOIN whose sender is not the key of the HELLO
